children: Third-quarter 2026 revenue rose 9.6% year over year to C$10.2M, while Adjusted EBITDA increased 24.6% to C$2.4M. Nine-month revenue rose 10.4% to C$29.6M and Adjusted EBITDA rose 9.7% to C$5.9M versus the same 2025 periods.

AI Analyst View
Q3 revenue rose 9.6% to C$10.2M YoY
Growth was broad-based across Pharmacy and Animal Health, indicating higher sales in both business units.
Q3 Adjusted EBITDA rose 24.6% to C$2.4M YoY
Profit growth outpaced revenue growth, though this non-IFRS measure includes adjustments.
Nine-month revenue rose 10.4% to C$29.6M YoY
Confirms growth across the year-to-date period; no full-year guidance was provided.
Nine-month Adjusted EBITDA rose 9.7% to C$5.9M YoY
Year-to-date profitability improved, with foreign-exchange losses and one-time implementation costs among the stated impacts.
Nine-month expenses rose 16.0% to C$12.9M YoY
Expense growth exceeded revenue growth, including higher staffing, ERP support, freight and other costs.
Cash was C$10.2M; borrowings were C$23.6M
Cash increased from C$7.7M at Dec. 31, 2025, while borrowings remain more than twice cash.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a mid-cycle operating update showing continued revenue growth and higher adjusted EBITDA across both the quarter and year to date. Further evidence of margin durability and expense control, alongside subsequent results or guidance, would be needed to establish a larger catalyst.
